name: npm-cli-pin
description: Hash-pinned npm CLI for sdk publish. Node 22 ships npm older than 11.5.1, the first release that can do GitHub OIDC trusted publishing. npm 11.21.0 still vendors brace-expansion 5.0.9, ip-address 10.5.0, and undici 6.28.0 inside its tarball; overrides cannot replace those inBundle copies, and no published npm release has bumped them. The direct dependencies below are the patched releases, and postinstall copies them over the bundle. The lockfile records those patched versions so dependency scanners see the tree CI actually runs.
